sections.kicker: Prepared for BETA5 Chocolates by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: BETA5 makes chocolates that look hand-painted. The front door hides both the chocolate and the name.
sections.keep: The painted bonbons themselves. Reindeer, gingerbread and peppermint swirls are unlike any chocolate box.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.area: The BETA5 wordmark sits in a pale grey box and fades into the photo behind it
pins.what: The logo is the faintest thing at the top of the page.
pins.why: The name is the least readable element on the front door. A new visitor sees chocolate but not whose.
pins.how: Give the wordmark its own solid ground and let it be the first thing read.
pins.label: Your logo
pins.cost: People enjoy the photo and cannot say whose chocolate it was.

pins.what: The menu lists Polygon Bars next to Bespoke, Collections and Event Orders.
pins.why: The names read like a catalogue. Nothing says why this chocolate and not another maker's, or what a polygon bar is.
pins.how: Name each line by what it is to the person eating it.
pins.label: Your menu
pins.cost: Newcomers browse labels they cannot decode and leave without learning what BETA5 is.

pins.area: A repeating grid of painted bonbons: reindeer faces, gingerbread men and peppermint swirls
pins.what: The hero is rows of hand-painted chocolates in identical boxes.
pins.why: The painted surface is what BETA5 owns. The page never says so in words, so the craft reads as decoration.
pins.how: Say in one line how these are made and let the painting lead the brand.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: A craft no one else has gets read as seasonal packaging.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at BETA5. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on BETA5's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
